shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat app/layout.tsx && rg --files lib __agent_eval__ && for f in lib/* __agent_eval__/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- app/page.tsx lib/projects.ts next.config.ts tsconfig.json && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); const h=fs.readFileSync('.next/server/app/index.html','utf8'); for(const s of ['Workspace','Loading member details','12 active projects']) console.log(s+': '+h.includes(s));\""

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('.next/server/app/index.html','utf8');let i=h.indexOf('active projects'); console.log(h.slice(i-100,i+50));\" && git diff -- next-env.d.ts && cat .gitignore"

/bin/bash -lc 'git show HEAD:tsconfig.json > tsconfig.json
git show HEAD:next-env.d.ts > next-env.d.ts'
